items.title: UP CEO’s rate threat adds wrinkle to Norfolk Southern merger process
items.summary: The railroad said Jim Vena’s remarks that he would raise rates on shippers who oppose the merger was an “offhand comment.”

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: ‘Humor is good,’ Union Pacific CEO says of video rate threat
items.summary: Union Pacific CEO said his threat to raise rates on shippers in a now-released video was an attempt at humor. The post EXCLUSIVE: ‘Humor is good,’ Union Pacific CEO says of video rate threat appeared first on FreightWaves.

items.title: Conrail tabs Wright as president and chief operating officer
items.summary: Conrail has appointed veteran rail executive John Wright as its new corporate leader. The post Conrail tabs Wright as president and chief operating officer appeared first on FreightWaves.

items.title: STB orders Union Pacific to make alleged rate hike threat video public
items.summary: Rail regulator rejects railroad’s appeal in dispute over remarks allegedly threatening shippers opposed to Norfolk Southern merger. The post STB orders Union Pacific to make alleged rate hike threat video public appeared first on FreightWaves.

items.title: Schneider & Norfolk Southern Unite for Domestic Intermodal Capacity
items.summary: SNDR and NSC collaborate to expand U.S. intermodal capacity, combining logistics expertise with rail infrastructure to boost freight efficiency.

items.title: Schneider National says rail partner shift offers network boost
items.summary: CEO Jim Filter said the company’s strategy strengthens its position as capacity tightens.

items.title: Norfolk Southern, Schneider National team to scale East Coast intermodal reach
items.summary: The railroad’s potential merger with Union Pacific is “the icing on the cake” of the partnership, Schneider CEO Jim Filter said.
